column1: # An entry's selected closure must be disjoint from every other entry's, so a
# helper that separate operations use is copied into each closure under another
# name rather than shared. Two copies that drift apart silently would be a
# divergence we created ourselves, so every copy is listed here and
# tests/doom-core/dup-check.rb holds it identical to its original, modulo the
# name. A new copy is added in the same commit that makes it.
# A third column lists the other copies a copy calls, as original=copy, so
# that a copy of a caller can call copies of its callees.
